records.statement: Reward-linked capture is supported but weak/method-sensitive in the traditional VDAC paradigm; ANT component reliability is uneven.
records.reasoning_rule: Do not infer attention strength or mechanism from one task or reward history alone.

records.statement: Information avoidance can be active and motivated; seeking and avoidance are not opposite endpoints of one curiosity scale.
records.reasoning_rule: Allow uncertainty/threat/cost to produce avoidance even when information value is high.

records.statement: Valuation and emotion interact but are not one latent construct and require distinct measurement.
records.reasoning_rule: Never use an affect score as a direct subjective-value score or vice versa.

records.statement: Identity measures are multidimensional and not perfectly invariant across cultures.
records.reasoning_rule: Require identity component and cultural/measurement context before comparing strength.

records.statement: Heuristic credibility cues can increase perceived credibility without establishing message truth.
records.reasoning_rule: Keep perceived credibility, source trust and factual accuracy as separate objects.

records.statement: PSI and PSR differ and parasocial effects can relate to both adaptive and maladaptive outcomes.
records.reasoning_rule: Do not infer a single beneficial connection score or collapse PSI into PSR.

records.statement: Sharing intention is not actual sharing, and incidental arousal has failed preregistered replication as a universal cause.
records.reasoning_rule: Prefer observed behavior; treat motive and arousal paths as conditional.

records.statement: Model-free RL, automaticity, repetition and habit are related but non-equivalent constructs.
records.reasoning_rule: No habit diagnosis from return rate, repetition, SRBAI, or model-free index alone.
